scenarios.name: Rift growth strata
scenarios.description: Differential subsidence, normal-fault slip episodes, migrating facies and accommodation-limited sediment packages.
scenarios.limits: Kinematic regional rift analogue. Faults bend along strike, not in dip. No stress-equilibrium solution.

scenarios.name: Reverse-fault growth strata
scenarios.description: Repeated reverse-fault slip with deposition between episodes and retained burial/loading histories.
scenarios.limits: Reverse-fault analogue; not a mechanically balanced fold-and-thrust belt or a curved-dip thrust model.

scenarios.name: Erosion and reburial
scenarios.description: An extensional history with a later prescribed erosional episode and subsequent sedimentation; irreversible material memories retained.
scenarios.limits: Prescribed erosion surface and pressure threshold, without a coupled uplift, erosion-transport or pore-fluid-flow solver.

scenarios.name: Curved-fault rift
scenarios.description: Dip-curved, along-strike-bent fault transport with growth strata and retained material history. Differential subsidence, normal-fault slip episodes, migrating facies and accommodation-limited sediment packages.
scenarios.limits: Volume-preserving prescribed kinematics. Dip flattens down-fault; vertical drained compaction. No stress equilibrium or balanced fold-and-thrust solution.

scenarios.name: Curved reverse-fault basin
scenarios.description: Dip-curved, along-strike-bent fault transport with growth strata and retained material history. Repeated reverse-fault slip with deposition between episodes and retained burial/loading histories.
scenarios.limits: Volume-preserving prescribed kinematics. Dip flattens down-fault; vertical drained compaction. No stress equilibrium or balanced fold-and-thrust solution.

scenarios.name: Curved-fault erosion and reburial
scenarios.description: Dip-curved, along-strike-bent fault transport with growth strata and retained material history. An extensional history with a later prescribed erosional episode and subsequent sedimentation; irreversible material memories retained.
scenarios.limits: Volume-preserving prescribed kinematics. Dip flattens down-fault; vertical drained compaction. No stress equilibrium or balanced fold-and-thrust solution.
